description: This class includes the collection of non-hazardous solid or non-solid waste, including mixed materials.
includes: collection of non-hazardous solid waste (garbage) in local areas: household and commercial waste
operation of waste transfer stations for non-hazardous waste
collection of recyclable materials (paper, glass, metals, plastics)
collection of used cooking oils and fats
operation of dustbins and waste bins in public places
collection of waste from construction and demolition sites (non-hazardous)
